status_note: Milestone 03 adds the simulation core, the save system and a playable campaign shell. The only system running is the calendar: one tick is one in-game day, and the game screen says so rather than showing numbers that do not exist. Economy, politics, diplomacy and military simulation remain planned.
about_paragraphs: WORLD DOMINION is a single-player, offline grand strategy sandbox about leading a nation through a living world. Politics, diplomacy, the economy, the military and international relations are intended to converge into one simulation in which every decision has consequences.

It is being built as one cross-platform game for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux rather than a desktop game adapted later. The simulation is designed to run entirely on the player's device, without accounts and without a backend.

Milestone 03 is the simulation core and the first playable campaign: a real clock, a real map, real saves and a shell to hold them together. The systems that will make the world move — economy, politics, diplomacy, military — belong to the milestones that follow.
